limits: Android 1.14.4/build 389 only on a physical device.
No separately signed application, APK modification or application-data reset.
No new exhaustive physical touch/IME matrix; grammar adapter unchanged from the previously user-tested trial.
Future-version AST tests use synthetic renamed/formatted fixtures; unsupported structures stop automatic activation.
postLiveChanges: External recovery also takes precedence when cache removal coincides with an official update (additional unit test).
Rebuild target identity is recorded before APK preparation, so early failures or interrupted upgrades cannot retry the same expensive work on every startup (additional unit tests).
Non-Android loading exits before accessing Android deployment state (additional unit test).
MIT license notices are embedded in the standalone helper.
The deployed native grammar, cache and bootstrap artifacts are unchanged from the timed device runs.
